facts.text: The user finds it hard to believe the Roman Empire's conversion to Christianity was solely based on religious conviction.
The user is skeptical of any kind of organized religion.
The user finds it hard to trust any organization or institution driven by power and influence.
The user believes every religion is corrupted by humans who seek to use it for their own gain.
The user thinks it is a shame that the message of love and hope can be distorted and twisted for selfish purposes.
